name: Sameera Agro and Infra Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 2002, Sameera Agro and 
Infra Ltd is in the business of agricultural commodities and infrastructure development[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
SAIL is in the business of Infrastructure & Construction. It diversified into the business of processing, drying, sale, purchase, marketing and distribution of agricultural commodities. Company has established a wide network of dealers and distributors for development of agri-business

pros: Stock is trading at 0.83 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Promoter holding has decreased over last quarter: -24.4%
